HUMAN_REVIEW.name: Chocolate Bar
HUMAN_REVIEW.recommendation: Do not generate a Cadbury/Nestlé/generic branded bar. Either capture the exact bar a participating merchant sells (then set brand later in a metadata phase) or keep imageless until the SKU is brand-identified.

HUMAN_REVIEW.name: Infant Formula
HUMAN_REVIEW.recommendation: Infant formula is high-risk. Only an official manufacturer asset or a merchant photo of the exact tin sold. Never generate or approximate NAN/SMA/Lactogen packaging.

GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.name: AA Batteries
GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.recommendation: Photograph a real 4-count AA pack or four AA cells with count visible. Previous generated image failed identity (cells did not read as AA). Count must MATCH 4.

GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.name: Baby Cereal
GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.recommendation: Photograph the actual Zimbabwe baby cereal sold (e.g. Nestlé Cereals/Nestum if that is the SKU) or a clearly infant-cereal pack. Previous generated image looked like TVP. If branded, treat as branded acquisition later.

GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.name: Exercise Book
GENERATION_DIFFICULTY.recommendation: Photograph a real unbranded or locally printed school exercise book. Do not generate covers with fake school crests or publisher logos.

COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.name: Bottled Water
COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.recommendation: Photograph an actual 10L container sold in Zimbabwe (often a rectangular 10L bottle, not a 5L jug or 18.9L cooler). Size mark must be visible. Generation previously collapsed to 5L/cooler.

COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.name: Pine Gel
COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.recommendation: Photograph a real 5L pine gel jerry. Do not generate a branded cleaning bottle. Size 5L must be readable or package geometry must unambiguously be 5L class.

COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.name: Stock Cubes Chicken
COUNT_OR_SIZE_SENSITIVE.recommendation: Photograph a real 12-count chicken stock cube pack. Previous H2.4 image showed 9 cubes and was reverted. Visible count must be 12, not 8/9/24. If branded (Knorr/Royco), treat as branded later.
